'''Tanno Vik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
As a child, Vik was put on a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] bound for the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] by his [[Tanno Vik's mother|mother]], where he would grow up there as a orphan. Tanno Vik moved from gang to gang where he learned to survive and fight, betraying his allies when the gang showed weakness or instability. To get off of the crime-infested moon Vik enlisted in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|Military]] and was bounced from posting to posting as his insubordination prevented him from taking on a placement with the [[Republic Special Forces Division]].<ref name="TORE" />

[[File:Tanno_Vik_on_Balmorra.jpg|thumb|left|Tanno Vik on Balmorra]]
As Vik was accused of criminal activity during his service, promotion did not seem likely, especially after a conviction in a case which named Vik as the mastermind of an exploitative racket on the planet [[Talay/Legends|Talay]]. Dismissed from the military, Vik made a living working as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] on the planet [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], seeking to get into the [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms]] Factory to steal its prototype weapons for profit. At the same time, [[Havoc Squad]] came to Balmorra to recruit him for a mission to take on an Imperial superweapon, codenamed [[Gauntlet (Sith Empire)|Gauntlet]]. General [[Elin Garza]] formally granted Vik the rank of Specialist once he was recruited. Vik proved useful in taking down the Gauntlet.<ref name="Target Acquisition">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Republic Trooper]]|Target Acquisition|[[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]}}</ref>

[[File:Tanno_Vik_on_Asylum.jpg|thumb|right|Tanno Vik returns to the life of organized crime.]]
During the Eternal Empire's Conquest, Vik's CO went missing. Soon afterward, Vik left the military and became a crime boss on the shadowport [[Asylum]], where he became rivals with [[Oggo]], the leader of a local [[Starbolts|crime syndicate]]. Vik later ran into [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]] after kidnapping one of their allies, [[Tora]], for stealing from him.<ref name="KOTFEChapter6" />

==Personality and traits==
As a mercenary, Vik learned to attack obstacles and threats by locating weaknesses with speed, which impressed his instructors when he entered Republic service. He utilized some of the most advanced items of weaponry that were available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Behind the scenes==
Tanno was first identified in an entry on The Old Republic website's Holonet databank which features [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] phrases such as "On Garza's List," "Red Hand Magaran," and "Language Aquisition Issues."

Tanno was voiced by [[David Anthony Pizzuto]], but due to David's untimely death in [[2012]], Tanno is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]] from ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' onwards.

In the sixth chapter of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'', the Outlander has the option to kill Tanno Vik but not recruit him, even if the player is a Trooper.
